notes.title: Steam Update - Achivements
notes.content:
[b]Merry greetings, everyone!
[/b]
We were alerted to a bug affecting Steam achievements in the game. Thanks to the help from our community members, we were able to diagnose and resolve the problem.
A big thank you to the community for your support in solving this issue!

[b]Summary of the fix included in this patch:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug preventing achievements from unlocking.
[/list]

Thank you!

[b]From the team @ Play on Worlds[/b]

notes.title: Build 1.2.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Merry greetings, everyone!

It was brought to our attention that there is a block bug involving the miner quest. This was an issue we understood was solved, but has come up with older save files. Thanks to some help from members of the community we were able to diagnose and solve the problem.

Thank you to the community for helping us solve this issue.

Below a summary of the fix with this patch: 

[list]
[*] Fixed the Miner's quest bug where, upon defeating the boss, the room in the Observatory remained locked and the quest NPC did not appear.
[/list]

Thank you!

From the team @ Play on Worlds

notes.title: Build 1.2.0.0
notes.content:
Summer Greetings everyone, we are excited to share an update on the development of Ebenezer and the Invisible World. 

When the game was released last year on Steam on November 3, 2024, we were very grateful to receive thoughtful feedback from the community. The team worked tirelessly to address launch bugs and QOL features to deliver the game we very much believe in. 

We made the decision to continue investing in Ebenezer and the Invisible World using feedback from the community as our roadmap. 

We are proud to share today the latest patch of Ebenezer and the Invisible World. Here are some of the updates you can expect: 

[list]
[*] [b]Tons of new map features[/b], ranging from zoom, to markers, and more
[*] Ability to [b]remap your controls[/b]
[*] Added [b]more Save points[/b] to reduce backtracking
[*] Added [b]more Fast Travel[/b] to traverse the map with more ease
[*] [b]Cleaner hit boxes[/b] for certain enemies to help the combat
[*] [b]Faster movement speed[/b] for Ebenezer.
[/list]

We have many more that you can read here:

[b]Steam Patch Notes 1.2.0 - Ebenezer and the Invisible World
[/b][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SCefk6A0pvShAk9s9fO3SzHNqdibRnC3j9bDYONX5G0/edit?usp=sharing]Ebenezer and the Invisible World (Version 1.2.0 Steam Patch Notes) - Google Sheets[/url]

Thank you all for all your feedback. We hope you enjoy the updates to the game!

Thank you!
From the team @ Play on Worlds

notes.title: 1.1.0.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Merry greetings everyone!

With the Holiday season right around the corner, we’ve prepared another update for your cheerful enjoyment!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Bedlam elevator doors visual issue
[*] Fixed Projectile Cane projectiles being invisible underwater
[*] Increased consumable item drop rates from breakable objects
[*] Increased map scroll speed
[*] Fixed some secrets not being revealed by the Compass heirloom
[/list]


Stay merry!

Luke
Community Manager

notes.title: 1.1.0.14 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Merry greetings everyone!

In the course of yet another week, a fresh iteration of improvements graces Ebenezer and the Invisible World! It brings me great joy to report that the most pressing of bugs now reside in the annals of the past. Nevertheless, our unwavering dedication persists, akin to a tireless artisan honing a masterpiece. 

Below is a rundown of the changes in Patch 1.1.0.14. As these improvements make their way to you, we want to extend our sincere thanks for your ongoing support and valuable feedback. We truly appreciate it!

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed dialogues getting jumbled under specific circumstances
[*] Fixed Ebenezer being able to hit himself with the Prisoner’s power
[*] Fixed issue with not being able to change consumables
[*] Fixed issue with Harpoonist sprite blinking
[*] Fixed issue with wrong consumable showing upon loading the game
[*] Fixed Spirit Upgrade Trader refusing to upgrade Ebnezer’s max Spirit
[*] Fixed issue with stair collision in specific area
[*] Fixed issue with Critical HP overlay not properly applying over the entire screen on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed Consumable UI not disappearing when Ebenezer dies with 0 consumables
[*] Fixed London boss respawning if Ebenezer dies before reaching a save room
[*] Removed rat from underwater level (we told him to find Kenji’s ring first)
[/list]

Stay merry!

Luke
Community Manager

notes.title: 1.1.0.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Merry greetings to all!

Thank you for taking the time to play our game. It has been a labor of love for almost two and a half years. Your feedback is very valuable to us, one could say it’s our guiding star. We’ve had an exciting launch day and now we would like to share some updates with you.

Below is a full list of fixes that come with the release of Patch 1.1.0.12. As we roll out these improvements, we express our heartfelt gratitude for your continued support and feedback. Thank you!

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed controller vibration not being disabled when turned off on the Settings menu
[*] Fixed Settings menu Exit button not working on the Steam Deck
[*] Fixed missing graphics options on the Settings menu
[*] Fixed incorrect font size in certain languages on the Settings menu
[*] Fixed “Critical Health” visuals and sound FX staying active after exiting to main menu
[*] Fixed instance of Malthus Guard hovering slightly above the ground in a specific area
[*] Fixed Ghost Challenges progression not counting properly
[*] Fixed missing ladder climb animation missing certain frames
[*] Fixed vanishing cursor on Settings menu
[*] Fixed invisible ledge in the Crypt before entering the Necropolis
[*] Fixed weird mouse cursor behavior on the Trader menu
[*] Fixed bug with “Santa Scrooge” skin when entering a mirror
[*] Fixed Ebenezer sometimes getting stuck between the movable blocks and the environment
[*] Fixed Cane attacks not working under specific conditions
[*] Fixed the "Beautiful Dress" quest item getting removed from inventory on death
[*] Fixed Spirit Elixirs missing from the Trader’s inventory
[*] Fixed Quest texts getting bugged if player dies after accepting quest but before saving the game
[*] Fixed Warren Gastrell getting stuck mid dash during [spoiler]rematch fight[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed Malthus Guard walking towards Ebenezer during dialogue with Warren Gastrell before [spoiler]rematch fight[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed Warren Gastrell using wrong dialog lines during [spoiler]rematch fight[/spoiler]
[/list]

Quality of Life Changes:
[list]
[*] Changed the angle at which the analog stick triggers Ebenezer’s ladder climbing
[*] Changed input handling to make it possible to jump and attack at the same time (not one after the other)
[*] Increased Ebenezer’s movement speed both with and without the Heirloom that increases run speed (Emi's Black Belt)
[*] Reduced intensity of screenshake on hitting enemies and getting hit
[*] Reduced amount of damage done by Wailing Wendy
[*] Increased size of item popups and their font sizes 
[*] Increased font size of Heirloom pickup popups
[*] Added an additional Save room in the London area
[*] Increased pickup hitbox size of the Warden’s quest item [spoiler](Letter)[/spoiler]
[/list]


We wanted to get as many of these fixes to you as soon as possible, so the patch may not include a fix for every issue you’ve brought up. Fear not, for we are continuing to test and improve the game and will continue releasing patches.

Stay merry!

Luke
Community Manager

notes.title: Ebenezer and the Invisible World Steam Next Fest Livestream
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Gamers![/h1]


We have been receiving incredible feedback this week on the demo. The team is hard at work looking into many of the comments raised. We are very grateful for your support, it means everything to us.

We are happy to announce that starting Monday, June 19th, Ebenezer and the Invisible World will be participating in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. A great way to support the game is to wishlist and share our Steam page with friends. The Steam algorithm promotes games with the most wishlists and it will help us get higher rankings on the Steam page for more people to learn about the game.
